title: Sorceress and Blue Scream
description: A woman in ornate black and gold fantasy armor with golden horns stands on white rocks, holding up a large spiral-bound sketchbook. The sketchbook displays a dramatic blue ink drawing of a woman's terrified face with wide eyes and open mouth.
prompt: A powerful sorceress with golden horns and elaborate black and gold armored outfit stands dramatically on white broken rocks in a barren desert landscape, holding up a large spiral sketchbook with her left hand. The sketchbook contains a striking blue ink portrait of a screaming woman with wide terrified eyes and open mouth. Dramatic golden hour lighting with radiating light beams and cinematic atmosphere.
